weight_justifications.slope: Provisional researcher-set priority for terrain inclination; not a rover safety threshold.
weight_justifications.local_relief: Provisional researcher-set priority for neighborhood elevation range.
weight_justifications.terrain_roughness: Provisional researcher-set priority for the configured elevation-dispersion measure; not traction.
weight_justifications.profile_curvature: Provisional researcher-set priority for along-slope terrain shape.
weight_justifications.plan_curvature: Provisional researcher-set priority for cross-slope terrain shape.
weight_justifications.topographic_position_index: Provisional researcher-set priority for relative local topographic position.
weight_justifications.landform_morphology: Provisional researcher-set priority for elevation-derived relative-position classes only.

optional_evidence: Independent elevation reference with compatible vertical datum
In-situ soil mechanics and bearing-strength observations
Wheel-soil traction and rover interaction observations
known_limitations: Feature weights are provisional researcher choices, not validated rover engineering priorities.
DEM morphology cannot establish soil mechanics, traction, dust behavior, subsurface composition, or material properties.
A digital elevation model does not reproduce planetary gravity, vacuum, radiation, or a complete planetary atmosphere.
Discovery confidence describes finite-sample distribution-distance variability only; it is not DEM measurement uncertainty.
A Copernicus GLO-30 DSM may include vegetation and built surfaces and is not necessarily bare-earth terrain.
Terrain similarity does not guarantee rover safety, mobility, or mission performance.

scale_bridge.target_resolution_basis: maximum of measured local ground pixel spacing and documented effective resolution; optional requested resolution may coarsen further
scale_bridge.resampling: area-weighted average; no upsampling below source sampling support

information_loss.planetary: No finer spatial detail is created. Source cells are averaged onto the comparison grid. The MOLA counts mask excluded zero-count bins; retained cells remain product-level MEGDR values and do not resolve sub-grid terrain.
information_loss.earth: Fine-scale terrain is aggregated to the coarsest comparison support and is not retained as resolvable detail in the output.

scale_bridge.vertical_comparison_status: relative terrain only; absolute elevations not compared
scale_bridge.vertical_normalization: Convert recognized linear units to metres, area-average, then subtract each source's own median over valid output cells; no vertical datum conversion.
